title: Per-kernel roofline coordinate projection
description: Closed-object schema for the per-kernel roofline-coordinate sidecar emitted by the shape-sweep elasticity fitter. Each record reports the operational intensity of the kernel, achieved bandwidth in GB/s, and resulting roofline-region label (compute-bound / L1-BW-bound / L2-BW-bound / HBM-BW-bound / latency-bound) fit from SimBench-BW shape sweeps, CUPTI Activity wall-clock, NVBit trace summaries, and NVML covariates. Records whose shape-sweep slope fit produces an R² below the pre-registered minimum are marked `roofline_fit_unreliable` and excluded from the cross-kernel map; records whose region label is inconsistent with the corresponding phase ledger emit `roofline_region_inconsistent_with_phase_ledger`.

shape_sweep_id.description: Identifier for the shape sweep this record was fit against; the sweep is itself a frozen artifact registered in the pre-registered shape-sweep TOML.

operational_intensity_flop_per_byte.description: Operational intensity in floating-point operations per byte of memory traffic. Computed from the kernel's static FLOP count divided by measured byte traffic at the dominant memory level.

achieved_bandwidth_gbps.description: Achieved bandwidth at the kernel's operating point, GB/s.

roofline_region_label.description: Roofline-region classification. The five primary labels are mutually exclusive admissible regions; `roofline_fit_unreliable` is the diagnostic label assigned when the shape-sweep slope fit produces an R² below the pre-registered minimum and the cell is excluded from the cross-kernel map.

r_squared.description: Coefficient of determination for the shape-sweep slope fit.

n_sweep_points.description: Number of shape-sweep points contributing to the fit.

phase_ledger_consistency_status.description: Cross-check result against the kernel's paired phase cycle ledger. The skipped status is set when the kernel's phase ledger was excluded from upstream consumers (overhead exceeded or boundary mapping unresolved); the cross-kernel map keeps the row but does not report a consistency verdict for that cell.

phase_ledger_latency_floor_cycles.description: phase-ledger-derived latency floor used in the consistency check, when available. Absent when phase_ledger_consistency_status is the skipped value.

latency_table_ref.description: Repo-relative path to the artifact that anchored the latency or phase-cycle floor used in this fit.
